name: TYC 6349-200-1
description: A star 0.96 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses that turns once in 3.41 days; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: radius 0.96 solar radii

mass.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: mass 0.85 solar masses

temperature.source: TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 206190624: Teff

spin.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 3.41 d and an axis 52 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

text.card: A star the Sun's width that turns once in 3.41 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Folsom et al. give it 0.96 solar radii, 0.85 solar masses, a rotation period of 3.41 days and an axis tilted 52° from the line of sight.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6882838031333427456 (quality A), from 2018yCat.1345....0G; Gaia DR3 measures none
